objective: Extend Politics Fantasy beyond legislators to verified legal parties and public non-elected political actors; prioritize new source ingestion and runnable tests
exposure: Design informed by previous BR30I and public official source catalogs. This is engineering-oriented pre-run registration, NOT confirmatory blinded research.
baseline: Current 2023 electoral atlas (59 labels), fictional actor universe and 2023 JEC manual transcriptions; no official party/person catalogue captured
expected_types: Evidence feasibility STOP where official raw unavailable; CODE+TEST results where locally executed; no invented real-party facts
grade_rule: VSDS1/3 CT2 20/100 multiactor and 24/100 legislative fixed until new field validation; N1/N2/N3=0 unless separately confirmed
